title: Agentic Knowledge Base
summary: Vibe Work now builds and maintains a structured personal knowledge base for you, replacing flat, intrusive memories with pages you can browse, edit, and trust. It removes the context cold start of new sessions by retrieving relevant facts only when semantically necessary, so your assistant has the right background without force-inserting stored details into unrelated answers.
whatsNew: Vibe Work now builds and maintains a structured personal knowledge base for you, replacing flat, intrusive memories with pages you can browse, edit, and trust. It removes the context cold start of new sessions by retrieving relevant facts only when semantically necessary, so your assistant has the right background without force-inserting stored details into unrelated answers.
keyCapabilities: File-based knowledge topics stored on browsable, editable pages instead of an opaque memory store, giving you full transparency and control over what the assistant remembers.
Relevance-first recall that retrieves knowledge only when semantically relevant to your query, preventing the assistant from surfacing unrelated facts.
Source attribution for recalled facts surfaced directly in the chain of thought and assistant message, so you always know where an answer came from.
Guided onboarding interview that bootstraps your knowledge base from scratch when no external sources are connected.
Full user and admin controls, including the ability to enable or disable the feature in Settings, a sensitive-data toggle in Privacy settings, and server-level configuration for enterprises.
